product.olivetti-m290-30.summary: The entry-level 286 offered alongside the 386SX M300 models.
product.olivetti-m290-30.history: In its September 1991 professional catalogue, Olivetti presented M290-30 (the entry-level 286 offered alongside the 386SX M300 models).
product.olivetti-m290-30.architecture: The board determines which peripheral combination needs verification. The guide identifies BA278 · WD90C11 · AT.
product.olivetti-m290-30.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records 2.01 · 27C010.
product.olivetti-m290-30.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m290-30.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m290-30.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, 22-1.
product.olivetti-m290-30.market: Olivetti, La gamma dei personal computer professionali, 3905621C-00, 9/91.
